note: Owen Henne (INF), a top portal signee, was drafted by the Cardinals (6th round) and signed pro — he won't join WVU.
Armani Guzman withdrew from the MLB Draft and announced his return to WVU — a big lift for the 2027 infield.
Kyle Casteel (RHP), an incoming signee, was drafted by the White Sox (11th rd) — a possible loss to the 2026 class if he signs pro.
Kyle Casteel signed with the White Sox (11th rd), forgoing his WVU career — the possible loss is now confirmed.
A federal injunction restored a fifth year to the 2022 high-school class — Brenen Lorient is the WVU name to watch, with one open scholarship and the NCAA appealing the ruling.

The same ruling makes six ex-Mountaineers eligible for 2026 — TE Jacob Barrick, DL Eddie Kelly Jr., CBs Jason Chambers and Tyrence Crutcher, S Fred Perry and P Oliver Straw. None has committed to return.
